q1.question: How do staff get access?
q1.answer: Admins invite staff and assign roles with least-privilege access.

q2.question: What can staff see vs doctors vs patients?
q2.answer: RBAC limits data per role; access can be audited.

q3.question: How do referrals link to scheduling?
q3.answer: Referrals can generate orders/requests that flow into facility queues and scheduling.

q4.question: How are results delivered?
q4.answer: Results are shared to authorized roles and surfaced in dashboards with notifications.

q5.question: How do pharmacies confirm fulfillment?
q5.answer: Pharmacies update fulfillment status (prepared/ready/delivered) and confirm completion.

q6.question: Is data secure?
q6.answer: Docito uses encrypted storage, RBAC, and audit trails to protect patient data.

q7.question: Can I use insurance?
q7.answer: Insurance support depends on providers and region; coverage options may appear during booking.

q8.question: Is mobile app available?
q8.answer: Mobile experiences are available today; native apps are coming soon.
